deviations.what: Hero headline set with fluid clamp() type rather than fixed 48/64px.
deviations.why: The file ships 1440px frames only. The clamp maximum equals the Figma value exactly at 1440, so desktop is pixel-faithful and only narrower viewports scale down.

deviations.what: Peyda (the family named by every FA type variable) is replaced by Vazirmatn.
deviations.why: CONFIRMED 2026-08-21 — Peyda and Maneli are both paid fontiran.com products with no redistributable cut, so the substitutes are the intended faces, not a stopgap: Vazirmatn for FA body text, Idealist → Doran FaNum → Vazirmatn (the font-display token) for eyebrows and display accents. Vazirmatn-SemiBold.woff2 (v33.003, SIL OFL) was added the same day so the weight-600 hero headline no longer renders as a synthesised bold. See GAPS.md G8.
